products.title: Products Catalog
products.subtitle: View, search, filter, edit, and manage all materials products (marble, granite, stone, quartz)

deleteDialog.title: Delete Product
deleteDialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{name}"? This will permanently remove the product and its associated gallery images from Cloudinary. This action cannot be undone.

toasts.deleteError: Failed to delete product. Please try again.

empty.noFilterResultsDesc: No products match the selected search and filter criteria.
empty.noProductsDesc: Get started by adding your first material product to the catalog.

error.title: Unable to load products
error.description: A network or server error occurred while retrieving products.

form.createSubtitle: Add a new material (marble, granite, stone, quartz) to the catalog.
form.editSubtitle: Update product specifications, attributes, and media gallery.

sections.basicInfoDesc: Specify product name, classification category, and primary material.
sections.attributesDesc: Add bilingual tags for colors, countries of origin, applications/uses, and surface finishes.
sections.mediaDesc: Upload high-resolution cover photo and up to 10 gallery images.

tags.colorDesc: Specify available color tones and shades for this material.
tags.originDesc: Specify quarrying or manufacturing origin countries.
tags.usesDesc: Specify recommended applications (flooring, cladding, stairs, countertops).
tags.surfaceDesc: Specify available surface treatments and finishes (polished, honed, flamed, etc.).
tags.empty: No items added yet. Enter Arabic and English values and click Add.
tags.pairRequired: Both Arabic and English values are required to add an entry.
tags.atLeastOne: At least one item is required.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.desc: Available size variants in centimeters (length × width × thickness). Optional.
dimensions.empty: No dimension variants added. Click "Add Dimension" to specify available sizes.

validation.required: All 3 values (length, width, thickness) are required for each entry

media.coverDesc: Primary featured photo of the material slab or installation.
media.galleryDesc: Upload up to 10 showcase images. ({count}/10 used)
media.dropCover: Click or drag an image here to set cover photo
media.dropGallery: Click or drag images here to add to gallery

toasts.partialUploadError: Product was created, but some image uploads failed. You can retry them here.
toasts.partialUploadCoverFailed: Product saved, but cover image upload failed. You can retry uploading it.
toasts.partialUploadGalleryFailed: Product saved, but gallery images upload failed. You can retry uploading them.
toasts.partialUploadBothFailed: Product saved, but cover and gallery image uploads failed.
toasts.deleteCoverError: Failed to remove cover image. Please try again.
toasts.deleteGalleryError: Failed to remove gallery image. Please try again.
toasts.createError: Failed to create product. Please verify inputs and try again.
toasts.updateError: Failed to update product. Please verify inputs and try again.
toasts.missingIdError: Product was created, but product ID was missing from server response.

errors.loadDesc: The product could not be retrieved. It may have been deleted or a server error occurred.

validation.nameArRequired: Arabic product name is required (at least 2 characters).
validation.nameEnRequired: English product name is required (at least 2 characters).
validation.materialArRequired: Arabic material is required (at least 2 characters).
validation.materialEnRequired: English material is required (at least 2 characters).
validation.colorRequired: At least one color is required.
validation.originRequired: At least one country of origin is required.
validation.usesRequired: At least one application/use is required.
validation.surfaceRequired: At least one surface finish is required.
validation.dimensionPositive: Length, width, and thickness must all be numbers greater than 0.
